d1.criterion_text: D1 Necessity score exactly 5 (blocking). Each Request/default-profile Response field is content, seed, control, output, or opaque; no debug-only fields in standard; no enum that only renames seed-if-present-else-infer.

d2.criterion_text: D2 Sufficiency score exactly 5 (blocking). Required+defaults complete capability or fail closed; every mandatory stored attribute has a named fill source; Response carries status/writes/errors and optional log row.

d3.criterion_text: D3 Non-overlap score exactly 5 (blocking). One job per field; aliases document winner + deprecation; multi-source attributes have stated precedence; default Response is not an audit echo stack.

d4.criterion_text: D4 Clarity score exactly 5 (blocking). Names match roles; defaults explicit; examples include a minimal third-party Request and optionally a seeded Request.

d5.criterion_text: D5 Consistency score exactly 5 (blocking). Modes, narrative, and persistence rules agree; no dead fields; ephemeral vs durable distinguished with generalization when needed.

d6.criterion_text: D6 Layering score exactly 5 (blocking). Request is call I/O not file schema; host tokens/states not required enums; callee owns schema.

d7.criterion_text: D7 Evolvability score exactly 5 (blocking). Version + changelog on field changes; alias winner + retirement path; additive optionals preferred over silent breaks.
